from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InstitutionData(BaseModel):
    """Metrics for a single university extracted from a CDS document."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the institution")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The CDS report year (e.g. '2021-2022')")
    national_appeal_index: float | None = Field(description="Percentage of freshmen from out of state")
    national_appeal_cohort: str | None = Field(description="The enrollment cohort used for the index (e.g. 'Fall 2021')")
    six_year_graduation_rate: float | None = Field(description="The six-year graduation rate percentage")
    graduation_cohort: str | None = Field(description="The graduation cohort year associated with the rate (e.g. 'Fall 2015')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    institutions: list[InstitutionData]
